change_note: Same measurement as v1. Only the scope widens: all four recorded instruments instead of MNQU6/GC, and the window runs to the last complete UTC day. No feature, barrier, horizon, purge rule or hyperparameter is altered, and nothing is selected on an evaluation score.
partition_note: v1 evaluated on 2026-09-03 UTC. In v2 that day is calibration and everything before it is training, so v2 scores are not independent of what v1 already reported. The v2 evaluation span 2026-09-04 to 2026-09-06 UTC was never scored by v1, but it is still reused development history, not a pre-registered out-of-sample set.
session_note: BTCUSDT trades continuously; the three futures symbols do not, and their last recorded bar is the 2026-09-04 weekend close. A shared UTC split therefore gives BTCUSDT roughly two evaluation days and the futures roughly one. Counts are not comparable across venues.
scale: mean previous 12 true ranges using 13 predecessors; max one tick
level_definition: previous reconciled footprint POC, tied max volume chooses lowest price
cooldown: none; all touches, overlap retained and disclosed
